intro: Lesson 125: Insulation practical: reducing unwanted energy transfer. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Do the cooling test with two materials and no wrap (or use the example data). Plot cooling curves and write a conclusion.
questions.a: Curves and conclusion linking material to rate of cooling
questions.model: Teacher records 50°C at time zero for the no-wrap cup on camera.

questions.q: Apply your results to loft insulation and cavity walls.
questions.a: Both trap air to reduce conduction and convection

questions.q: Explain why the cooling curve gets less steep with time. (2)
questions.a: Temperature difference to the room falls (1) so the rate of energy transfer falls (1)

questions.q: Which result is best and why? (2)
questions.a: Wool with lid, smallest drop (1); traps air and stops convection and evaporation from the top (1)
questions.model: Name the best with data, then explain with transfer methods.
